data.title: Sync compact locale menu foundation
data.body:
## Outcome

Synchronizes the shared compact-header locale-menu containment fix from OverKill Hill.

- Anchors the language disclosure to the viewport at compact widths.
- Regenerates the stylesheet fingerprint across all public pages and service-worker cache entries.
- Refreshes the public shared-stylesheet line-count statistic generated from the changed CSS.
- Leaves site-specific JavaScript and Mermaid foundations byte-identical to the shared source.

## Validation

- Site validation: 63 pages, 0 issues, 0 warnings
- CSP: 63 pages current
- Links: 2,690 internal + 1,098 external, 0 broken/style issues
- Unit tests: 5 pass
- Portfolio statistics: current
- Static responsive inventory: 63 pages × 8 viewports, 504/504 pass
- Injected real-browser menu proof: 320, 375, and 390 px all contained at 8 px..viewport−8 px
- `git diff --check`: pass

Exact head: `2b7143a347af064ed946418a0f3699e616c4b0a4`.
